name: memory
description: Explicit private local memory with atomic lessons and decisions, structural review, and an approval-gated durable candidate queue

capabilities.name: memory.lesson_write
capabilities.description: Append explicit lessons atomically to private local memory

capabilities.name: memory.decision_write
capabilities.description: Allocate stable ADR identifiers and append explicit decisions atomically

capabilities.name: memory.health
capabilities.description: Check expected private memory files and structural invariants without exposing content

capabilities.name: memory.review
capabilities.description: Produce a read-only review of explicitly marked open actions

capabilities.name: memory.candidates
capabilities.description: Add, list, approve, reject and expire candidate memories; durable Markdown is written only after explicit approval

health_checks.description: Verify private memory structure and ADR counter consistency

storage.description: Private lessons, decisions, preferences and explicitly approved candidate memory
Pending, approved, rejected and expired memory candidate state
ADR allocation counter and lock state
